headline: Before elections in UP, development roadmap of Rs 30,000 crore; CM Yogi gives green signal for construction of roads and bridges
summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi approved a development roadmap for new roads, bridges and culverts at an estimated cost of about Rs 30,000 crore. MLAs submitted construction proposals for their areas.
why: Large state infrastructure programmes drive demand for construction and materials and reflect public spending priorities in India's largest state.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
